summary: Dynagas LNG Partners LP filed a Form 6-K on July 23, 2026, announcing a routine quarterly cash distribution of $0.5625 per Series A Cumulative Redeemable Perpetual Preferred Unit. The distribution covers the period from May 12, 2026, to August 11, 2026, payable on August 12, 2026, to holders of record as of August 5, 2026. This is the 44th sequential distribution since the units began trading on the NYSE. The filing contains no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or management change; it is a standard periodic filing reporting a declared preferred dividend. The registrant is the issuer of the preferred units. What to watch: This is purely a routine capital-returns event with no risk-arb angle.
